cohort: The cohort consisted of 847 newly pregnant women recruited from 37 general practices in London, UK.
finding: The overall prevalence of Chlamydiales was 4.3%, but no infection was significantly associated with miscarriage at <=12 weeks or preterm birth <37 weeks.
gest_age: Follow-up was performed at 16 weeks gestation and at term, with outcomes including miscarriage at <=12 weeks and preterm birth <37 weeks.
